title: Method returns null
guidance: Return Optional<T> for a single absent value, or an empty collection.

title: Imperative Optional unwrapping (isPresent)
guidance: Use map / flatMap / filter / orElseGet / orElseThrow / ifPresentOrElse.

title: Optional.orElse(null) reintroduces null
guidance: Keep the value inside the Optional pipeline, or use orElseThrow / orElseGet with a real default.

title: Manual null comparison
guidance: Use Objects.requireNonNull for guards, Optional.ofNullable for absent values.

title: Optional used as a field, parameter or record component
guidance: Optional is only for return types and local variables.

title: String.isBlank() instead of a null-safe helper
guidance: Use a null-safe helper such as StringUtils.hasText.

title: switch statement
guidance: Prefer Strategy or map dispatch. An exhaustive switch over a sealed type is fine.

title: instanceof type check
guidance: Use polymorphism or a type-keyed registry.

title: if/else branching
guidance: A guard clause, Optional pipeline or Stream filter may read better.

title: Imperative loop
guidance: Streams may read better than a loop with an accumulator. Ignore for index logic or early exits.

title: Concrete *Impl type injected or declared
guidance: Depend on the interface, unless this repository says to use the impl inside its own module.

title: @Value injection
guidance: Bind configuration through a @ConfigurationProperties record instead of scattered @Value fields.
